findings.statement: The FR BTP devis/facture/chantier-management segment is CROWDED (Obat, Trustup Pro, EBP, Evoliz, BatUp, OrgaVision, Axonaut, Sellsy… 11+ compared), list prices ~25–43 €/mo, most now Factur-X / e-invoice compliant.
findings.implication: M2 cannot differentiate on basic devis/facturation alone — V145/V147 differentiator (cross-document coherence + BTP document intelligence) is the correct wedge.

findings.statement: Quantity takeoff / métré from plans (PDF/DWG/BIM) is a MATURE, specialised market with AI entrants (Kreo, Togal.AI, Planaliz) and incumbents (JustBIM, PriMus, Bluebeam Revu).
findings.implication: §3.1 plan-reading/métré is a HARD, competitive capability requiring real geometry/BIM tooling — must be roadmapped as FUTURE/owner-gated, NEVER faked; the engine must refuse to invent a scale/dimension/métré and ask for human measurement.

findings.statement: Prioritise document-intelligence + coherence (built V147) and chantier-level profitability reconciliation as the near-term vertical; defer plan-métré and regulatory-conformance engines to owner-gated phases with expert validation.
findings.implication: feeds the progressive BTP roadmap priorities (V147_BTP_ROADMAP).
